content.query:
SELECT 
     UPPER(TABLE_SCHEMA) TABLE_SCHEMA,UPPER(TABLE_NAME) TABLE_NAME,UPPER(MIN(COLUMN_NAME)) COLUMN_NAME
FROM 
    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE UPPER(COLUMN_NAME) IN ('AS_OF_DATE','AAS_AS_OF_DATE','FILE_NAME','INSERT_DTTM') 
AND TABLE_SCHEMA IN ('BUSC','EDS')
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%TEST%' 
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%DELTA%' 
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%20%' 
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%BACKUP%' 
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%BKUP%'  
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%TEMP%'  
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%GROUP_SRC%'  
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%DAY%'  
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%PROD%'  
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%C_REPRINT%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%SCD%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%C_REPRINT%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%CTAS%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%SOURCE_VS_TARGET%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%DELETE%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%VW_%'
AND UPPER(TABLE_NAME) NOT LIKE '%MV_%'
GROUP BY 
 UPPER(TABLE_SCHEMA) ,UPPER(TABLE_NAME)
